reason: Creators keep asking me for free services and none of them can show me a single paying customer, so a free count I can check against my own bill book is worth trying. If it shows ten real customers I don't mind ₹299; if it shows nothing, I've got my answer to give the next creator.
objection: My staff are busy with clients, they will forget to type the PIN or note the code, and then the count is wrong and I am paying for numbers I can't trust. Also the creator sends the link, so the creator controls it, not me.
would_change_my_mind: If after the free month the evening counts don't match my bill book, or my staff keep missing codes, I stop and won't pay.
